lead: Karan Johar is a widely followed Indian film director, born on 25 May 1972 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, he is 54 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.

He is associated with work such as Kuch Kuch Hota Hai and Koffee with Karan and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Director and National Film Award for Best Popular Film Providing Wholesome Entertainment.
The sections that follow break down Karan Johar's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Karan Johar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Karan Johar was born on 25 May 1972 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Yash Johar and his mother, Hiroo Johar.
He studied at Green Lawns High School and H. R. College of Commerce and Economics.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2017, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2018 and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2019.
